title: A Thousand Ways to Make Music

collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: A drummer asks whether distant people make unimagined music, and whether they still sing to children at bedtime.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A drummer asks whether distant people make music with instruments no Isolan has imagined, and whether they still sing to children at bedtime.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The musicians invent sounds made by strings, metal, wind, and vibrating surfaces.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: An ambitious experiment produces a terrible noise; the village politely requests a pause.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A parent hums a melody and wonders whether a distant parent is doing the same.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A villager says some children prefer silence; the group smiles at the thought.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Two musicians argue about rhythm and discover a delightful new pattern.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The disagreement persists; they agree that not every taste must be shared.
